notes: The QSPI/OSPI bus protocol does not define OTP. Device identity and capability are discoverable in-band via Read JEDEC ID (0x9F) and SFDP (0x5A). Individual NOR-flash devices may add a vendor OTP/security region, but that is a device feature outside the xSPI bus spec.

otp_equivalent_factory_burned_fields.note: Density, supported read modes, dummy-cycle / mode-bit counts, erase types, address bytes (JESD216).
Many devices provide a factory-programmed unique ID.
Some NOR flash add a small one-time-programmable security region; this is a device feature, not part of the bus protocol.
